entries.title: Claude accounts manager
entries.text: Every Claude account on the VPS in one ordered list: subscriptions and API keys alike. Drag a row to change the order the build orchestrator follows. Right-click a row to rename it, move it or open Claude Code as that account.

entries.title: Claude accounts manager settings
entries.text: The banner widget, the Terminal column, the floating overlay window and its buttons, and the plan prices used for dollars.

entries.title: Claude accounts manager
entries.text: Opens the ordered list of Claude accounts.

entries.title: Claude Code as an account
entries.text: Opens a Terminal tab running Claude Code on the VPS host as that account, on its own copy of the login.

entries.title: Add a Claude account
entries.text: Opens the Terminal and starts the Claude login (subscription) or the hidden API key prompt (API key) for a new account.

entries.title: Accounts overlay
entries.text: Shows or hides the floating accounts window: custom buttons, resizable, size lock, docking, minimize, console or whole-screen.

entries.title: Pick an account
entries.text: The banner widget's drop-down: every account with what is left; tap one to show it on the banner.
